reason: A modular capability library for extending DeepSeek Harness with a broad ecosystem of plugins covering agent orchestration, research, browser and MCP integrations, sessions, memory, tools, and observability.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的模块化插件库，通过扩展接缝提供智能体编排、研究、浏览器与 MCP、会话记忆及工具等能力。
summaries.en: A modular plugin library for DeepSeek Harness that adds agent orchestration, research, browser and MCP integrations, session memory, tools, and observability through documented extension seams.

capabilities: Registers modular plugins for DeepSeek Harness through documented extension seams
Provides agent orchestration and child-agent execution
Uses shell and filesystem providers for tools and Git/GitHub workflows
Supports web search, fetching, browser automation, and MCP integrations
Stores, retrieves, shares, and exports session and memory data
Adds policy, approval, scanning, monitoring, and observability features
